[[File:Rodian_pin-up.png|thumb|right|200px|A Rodian pin-up poster with a message to Jason]]
'''Jason''' was an individual who, at one point prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], had received a [[Rodian pin-up/Legends|pin-up]] of a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="Pursuit">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Jason" is included within a message written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on a pin-up poster of a Rodian. Displayed on the top-right corner of the image, the message reads, "To Jason X0X0".<ref name="Pursuit" /> The poster first appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," where it is seen from far away and the Aurebesh caption is barely readable.<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> The poster is first seen in close-up in an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]] in "[[Pursuit of Peace]]."<ref name="Pursuit" />
